description: Aljal Ipsi (알잘 입시): Get a short summary for one id returned by search_admissions: a university (documents held per entrance year), one admission guide (its tracks and seats), one admission track (eligibility, CSAT minimum, schedule as written in the guide), or a major (universities offering it and seats). Returns a summary in Korean (values quoted as written in the guide), the publication date of the guide, and the page URL, not full tables. search_admissions 가 준 id 하나의 요약입니다.
name: get_admission_details
title: 입시 정보 요약 보기
